findings.detail: The first section was written at 56a3277bd, before the shaped-section repair (92ec74686), and was never corrected when sections 2 and 3 were appended. It states 'The plant build itself ... stops on a defect one layer past the loader' and 'The two DINA arms and the reconstruction-tolerance arm are therefore not met and are reported as not met'; its Gate paragraph heads the run at 1eacfd3c8, not at the reviewed head. The completed outcome lives in the sibling fragment docs/evidence/fragments/iter-passive-plasma-circuit/unseen-source-shaped-section-flux.html, which is not the file the done-when points a reader at. A coordinator reading the named fragment for writeback is told the opposite of the manifest's 'Done-when (1) MET / (2) MET'.

findings.detail: The fields read 'one all_debug job: for each of tests/test_prescribed_plasma.py, ... a fresh process at head' and 'the same job: git archive 2c14b3ffc into a /tmp tree removed by trap, ...'. The manifest contract refuses a sentence naming the suite instead of the literal command, and the log carries no '# command:' header to fall back on.
findings.summary: The manifest carries no `tests:` key and its after_suite/baseline_suite `command` fields are prose, so the gate receipt cannot be re-run.

findings.detail: The last line is '=== DONE Wed Oct 21 07:28:51 PM UTC 2026+0000' and the file contains zero lines matching `^EXIT=`. Per-file `EXIT_FILE=<file>=<code>` markers are present inside it, but the per-arm terminator promotion reads is absent, so the manifest's exit_status is the only source for the arm status.
findings.summary: The gate log has no bare `EXIT=<code>` last line, so the gate's own status is unread from the log.

findings.detail: Lines 417-419 sit at column 0 inside test_thin_polygon_strip_is_integrated_not_missed while their leading comment line is indented. ruff format does not reindent comment bodies, so the node's path-scoped lint pass did not catch it.
findings.summary: A comment continuation is left at column 0 inside a function body, breaking the file's indentation style.
